administration: Read aloud by a trained facilitator or played as audio. Girls answer by tapping a picture scale. Given at enrollment (pre) and at the end of the program (post).
note: These items are working drafts for cognitive testing with the youth advisory group. Before the study, each domain will be aligned with or supplemented by a validated instrument adapted for Rajasthan (see docs/outcomes.md), subject to its license terms.

label.en: Comfort with my body and period

text.en: I feel comfortable talking about my period with a woman I trust.
I feel I can manage my period without shame.
I feel ashamed of my body.
I feel good about who I am.
I can solve problems that come up in my life.
I know at least one adult I could tell if I felt unsafe.
I know that I can say no to a touch I do not want.
I know a helpline I could call if I needed help.
I could tell my mother or another adult if something felt wrong in my body.
I could explain my symptoms to a health worker.
I can say what I need, even when it is hard.

label.en: Ability to act on health information

text.en: I know which body signs mean I should see a health worker.
I know where to go in my village to get health care.
If I had a health problem, I would ask for help instead of waiting.

knowledge_test.description: Correct answers from the curriculum quizzes, scored as percent correct. The same items are asked before and after the program.
